thread:
maria: heads-up — i'm landing a docs PR to cover Windows time sync and cert-chain steps for airgapped/private installs. link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1987

sam-docs: nice. can you include a short PowerShell snippet for importing the HSM intermediate cert and a scheduled resync? testers kept missing the cert store step.

maria: yep. adding both the cert import and a minimal scheduled task. also adding a note about service account permissions. snippet below: 
```powershell
# import intermediate cert into LocalMachine
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\\hsm-intermediate.crt -CertStoreLocation Cert:\\LocalMachine\\CA
# register a one-time scheduled resync as SYSTEM (example)
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'w32tm.exe' -Argument '/resync'
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At (Get-Date).AddMinutes(1)
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'RedwoodTimeSync' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -RunLevel Highest -User 'NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM'
```

lee-engr: small heads-up — on sealed/offline sites you often need to set the time service to use the local CMOS fallback. add this registry tweak in the note: `Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\W32Time\\Parameters' -Name 'Type' -Value 'NoSync'` and then do a manual resync after installing certs.

maria: good call. i'll add a short section "offline sites / no domain" with that reg tweak + explanation.

sam-docs: can you also add a tiny troubleshooting table: symptom -> likely cause -> one-liner fix? e.g. "w32time refuses to start -> missing intermediate cert in machine store -> import cert + restart service". keeps support ping time down.

maria: on it. also adding a Windows example for verifying HSM PKCS11 middleware is present (common source of failures): `Get-ChildItem 'C:\\Program Files\\VendorPKCS11'` and note about PATH.

ops-bot: CI / docs linkcheck failed on PR #1987 — broken anchor: docs/private/install#time-sync-ntp-windows -> 404.

maria: thanks ops-bot. fixing anchors and adding an explicit anchor id in the markdown so linkcheck is stable across TOC moves.

lee-engr: ping @sam-docs once you push the fixes. i can run a quick smoke on a Windows VM this afternoon (12:30 PT).

sam-docs: will review after your push, maria. quick checklist for the PR description please: 1) mention tested OS versions (Windows Server 2019/2022), 2) list HSM vendors validated, 3) add link to sample PS1 file in examples/

maria: added all 3. also included a short section "what not to do" (don't import cert into Personal store, avoid using local user accounts for scheduled tasks).

lee-engr: thanks — small nit: change `Cert:\LocalMachine\\CA` -> `Cert:\LocalMachine\\Intermediate Certification Authorities` for clarity (some readers get confused by store aliases).
